name: judge-reliability
description: Who judges the judge? A small, careful study of LLM-as-judge bias: position, length and self-preference, against 120 hand-labelled pairs.

scripts.label: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/label.ts
scripts.smoke:keychain: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(security find-generic-password -s aussie-data-mcp-anthropic -w) npm run smoke --
scripts.generate:keychain: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(security find-generic-password -s aussie-data-mcp-anthropic -w) npm run generate --
scripts.pad:keychain: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(security find-generic-password -s aussie-data-mcp-anthropic -w) npm run pad --
scripts.judge:keychain: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(security find-generic-password -s aussie-data-mcp-anthropic -w) npm run judge --

author: Dylan Lewis
